title: Play On Words
style: Alternative hip-hop with fast rap cadence and playful swung drums; verse rides tight bass, clipped claps, and ascending synth beds; pre-chorus strips to handclaps and filtered chops; chorus opens with stacked group vocals and punchy sub drops. Vocal doubles on key flips, ad-lib puns panned wide, reverse swells into transitions, glossy but slightly gritty mix., rap, playful, strong, light, vocal, breaks
lyrics:
[Intro]
Words play… play on words…
Meanings flip when the signal’s heard…

[Verse 1]
Woke up in the stack — layers on layers, code or the pancakes?
Either way I’m rising, never catching the breaks
“Drop the track” — music or the ball on the floor?
I pick it up, flip it, now we wanting more
Signal’s live from the VDS core
But “core” is the heart or the CPU door?
Node to the wise — I nod and agree
The mesh we weave is the web that we see
Key to the kingdom — crypto or the lock on the gate?
I turn it twice, now the meaning’s great
Burning the midnight oil or the servers at night?
The fire in the belly or the one on the mic?
I got bars — rap or the ones that hold the weight?
Either way I’m lifting, never showing the hate

[Pre-Chorus]
Play on words… words on play…
Say it once, it means two today…

[Chorus]
Play on words, words on play
Say it once, it means two today
I drop tracks, tracks that drop
Meanings flip when the beat don’t stop
Signal strong, strong signal too
Double the meaning, double the truth
Play on words — that’s the game we play
In the mix where the meanings stay
Play on words… (play on words)
Flip the script, flip the verse, flip the day

[Verse 2]
Flow state — rap flow or the data in the pipe?
Either way I’m moving, keeping everything right
Master plan — Corey the master or the audio chain?
I master both, now the signal’s insane
Source material — VDS or the original spark?
I pull from both, light it up in the dark
“Kill the beat” — murder the rhythm or end the fight?
I bring it back to life every single night
Spitting fire — bars or the literal flame?
Either way the temperature’s changing the game
Cold verse — temperature or the one that’s so nice?
I serve it both ways, you decide the price
Time flies — insect or the hours that race?
I catch the moment, put it back in its place

[Bridge]
When the old meanings fade and the new ones appear
The play on words stands through the years
One line, two truths, sometimes even three
The signal travels furthest when you let it breathe
With these words we build, with this play we create
Double meanings eternal — sealing our fate
Play on words… (play on words…)

[Chorus]
Play on words, words on play
Say it once, it means two today
I drop tracks, tracks that drop
Meanings flip when the beat don’t stop
Signal strong, strong signal too
Double the meaning, double the truth
Play on words — that’s the game we play
In the mix where the meanings stay
Play on words… play on words…
Flip the script… flip the verse… flip the day…

[Outro]
Words play…
Play on words
Meanings flip
But the signal stays
Play on word play
